{"consolidated_memory":"**Flaky jobs in build/ci/pipeline.yml (four separate occasions, 2026-03-05 to 2026-06-11)**

All work occurred in the same corner of build/ci/pipeline.yml; context carried over between fixes.

**Occasion 1: 2026-03-05 – Nested inputs beyond six levels**
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind lazy relation
- Signal: one job failing on minority of runs
- Reproduction: rerun the same commit ten times
- Fix: prefetched the relation in single query
- PR #5538, branch fix/flaky-job-1
- Outcome: cold start performance dropped 57%, to 91 ms

**Occasion 2: 2026-04-19 – Jobs scheduled across midnight boundary**
- Trigger: jobs scheduled across midnight boundary
- Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
- Signal: one job failing on minority of runs
- Reproduction: rerun the same commit ten times
- Fix: moved arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR #5672, branch fix/flaky-job-2
- Outcome: backlog cleared 30 minutes after deploy

**Occasion 3: 2026-05-15 – Accounts in five percent rollout bucket**
- Trigger: accounts in five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: cache entry never invalidated on write
- Signal: one job failing on minority of runs
- Reproduction: rerun the same commit ten times
- Fix: invalidated entry inside write transaction
- PR #9110, branch fix/flaky-job-3
- Outcome: p99 latency fell from 9.9 s to 555 ms

**Occasion 4: 2026-06-11 – First request after cold start**
- Trigger: first request after cold start
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Signal: one job failing on minority of runs
- Reproduction: rerun the same commit ten times
- Fix: capped attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #9371, branch fix/flaky-job-4
- Outcome: alert stayed quiet for 89 consecutive days"}
